administration.before: A 25-account list page executed the count and list reads plus per-account committee and access-profile reads: 52 prepared reads without a department expansion.
administration.after: The same page executes one count, one purpose-limited account projection, one set-wise committee hydration, and one set-wise access-profile hydration: 4 prepared reads, or 5 when the page contains at least one department reference.
administration.privacy: The list projection does not use SELECT a.* and excludes credential_json and other credential material. Single-account detail hydration retains its existing complete projection path.

change.restocking: The Restocking bootstrap no longer reads generic requests or request lines that its response does not return.
change.procurement: The Procurement bootstrap no longer reads the generic inventory catalog page that its response does not return.

lending.catalogFixture: The regression fixture contains 60 active catalog items and assets. A one-ticket, page-size-one Lending bootstrap returns the one visible catalog item plus the ticket-linked item, and asset candidates are restricted to those two item identities.
lending.historyFixture: The visible ticket has 22 status-history rows. One set-wise query ranks only visible ticket identities, retrieves the latest 21 rows per ticket as a 20-row display bound plus one sentinel, returns the latest 20 in chronological display order, and sets historyHasMore=true.
lending.frontendTruth: historyHasMore is a required fail-closed boolean in the frontend adapter, is preserved through preview transitions, and visibly discloses that older history remains in the authoritative record.

performance.claimBoundary: No live D1 rows_read, SQL duration, endpoint latency, Web Vitals, p50, or p95 improvement is claimed from deterministic local tests.

review.responseContract: Equivalent business and authorization behavior is preserved except for the deliberate additive historyHasMore field and its truthful UI disclosure.

rollback: Revert source commit 9a82307ed422ce02bd6e164716e8d8d7a10a826b. No schema, migration, index, provider, deployment, data, main, or Production rollback is required.
